title: exec.jsonl task record
description: One JSON object on a single line of jobs/exec.jsonl.

uuid.description: Task identifier (also the done marker file name).

model.description: Model id when the engine accepts a model flag (null for shell).

command.description: Shell command line executed by the DAG runner.

depends.description: Upstream task UUIDs that must succeed first.

result_path.description: Path to the result markdown file for this task.

step_name.description: Handler step id for this record.

resume_from_uuid.description: UUID of the parent session to resume.

env_passthrough.description: Environment variable names exempt from filtering.

safe_default_applied.description: Whether the default permission preset was applied.

safe_default_preset.description: Name of the automatically selected permission preset.

annotations.description: Structured metadata not passed on the CLI argv.

idempotency_key.description: Dispatch deduplication key when set by the intake tower.
